hooks.name: Update Report on Task Complete
hooks.description: After each completed spec task, updates the report.md with what was done.

action.prompt:
A spec task in CamEventFlow just completed. Update report.md by appending a new entry under the relevant Day section. Include:
- Task name
- Files created or modified
- Any important decisions made
- Any integration holes touched or implemented
Keep the entry concise (bullet points). Do not rewrite existing report content.
